title: Resolution of Vectors — Finding Components
notes: **Fig(i): a force of 10 N acts at 30° from the y-axis.** Taking components along y and x: $F_y=F\cos30°=10\times(\sqrt3/2)=5\sqrt3\,\text{N}\approx8.66\,\text{N}$, $F_x=F\sin30°=10\times0.5=5\,\text{N}$.

**Fig(ii): a force of 10 N acts at 45° from the y-axis.** $F_x=F\cos45°=10\times(1/\sqrt2)=5\sqrt2\,\text{N}\approx7.07\,\text{N}$, $F_y=F\sin45°=5\sqrt2\,\text{N}\approx7.07\,\text{N}$ (here $\sin45°=\cos45°$, so both components come out equal).
